basic_details.short_information: Kalakshetra Foundation (कलाक्षेत्र प्रतिष्ठान) is recruiting for 1 post of Consultant (Outreach and Museum) on a contract basis. Candidates apply by post on the Annexure-I form, sent to The Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Anna Street, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai - 600 041. The application must reach the Director by 6 November 2026 (Friday). Kalakshetra Foundation is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India.

age_limit.details: Candidates must not be older than 45 years on the closing date for receipt of applications, which is 6 November 2026. The competent authority in Kalakshetra Foundation reserves the right to relax the eligibility criteria and other terms and conditions for deserving candidates.

content_sections.heading: About Kalakshetra Foundation
content_sections.text: The notice describes Kalakshetra Foundation as an Institution of National Importance and an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India. Its address in the notice is Anna Street, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai. This post serves the Foundation's outreach work and its museum.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by post only, on the form given as Annexure-I in the notice. The notice gives these steps: Download the application form given as Annexure-I in the notification. Fill in the application completely. Attach self-attested copies of your testimonials. Send the application by post to: The Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Anna Street, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai - 600 041. Make sure the application reaches the Director by 06.11.2026 (Friday), the last date for receipt. A photograph, fixed in the box on the form. Your name (in BLOCK letters), your address for communication, your date of birth (in Christian era), two mobile numbers and your email ID. Your educational qualifications (Class X, Class XII, Diploma, Degree, PG and Others), with the year of passing, the University and the % of marks for each. Your experience in chronological order, with the total in years, months and days. For each job, give the designation, the organisation, the nature of duties and the From/To dates. A description of your experience in Outreach activities and in Museum Curation. Your knowledge of Bharatanatyam / Carnatic Music. Your knowledge of the South Indian languages Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam and Kannada: whether you can speak, read and write each one. Why you consider yourself suitable for the post, and any other information you wish to add. A signed declaration, with the place and date. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post, Consultant (Outreach and Museum). The salary is commensurate with the experience. Bachelor Degree from a recognized University or Diploma/Post Diploma from Kalakshetra Foundation. Knowledge in the field of art and culture especially in the field of Bharatanatyam/Carnatic Music/Visual arts/Crafts. Knowledge in Tamil, Hindi. Excellent writing / editing and verbal communication skills Demonstrated ability with social media management and promotional / marketing strategies Excellent interpersonal skills Knowledge of layout and design for print and web-based promotional materials Ability to work on time bound tasks, organize work assignments, set priorities and meet deadlines Ability to be flexible and adaptable in order to contribute to problem-solving activities within a growing organization Ability to work and co-ordinate with diverse groups of individuals Solid computer skills (Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, CorelDraw etc.) Experience in management of online streaming platforms Organizing Webinars through Video conferencing platforms Creativity in presentation of concepts Cataloguing of museum artefacts under different categories Maintenance of backups of all data and storage of data as per the guidelines of Kalakshetra Foundation Taking care of museum artefacts Candidates must not be older than 45 years on the closing date for receipt of applications, which is 6 November 2026. The competent authority in Kalakshetra Foundation reserves the right to relax the eligibility criteria and other terms and conditions for deserving candidates. The appointment is on a contract basis for one year. It is extendable on a year-to-year basis, subject to the candidate's satisfactory performance during the contract. In the declaration on the form, candidates accept that the appointment, if selected, is purely temporary with no claim to any regular appointment. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of testimonials Photocopies of educational qualification certificates (the form asks for them under item 6) A photograph fixed on the application form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Kalakshetra Foundation will shortlist candidates from the applications received. Only shortlisted candidates will be told the date and time of the interview, at a later stage.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If an applicant's experience certificate cannot be verified with the institution where they last worked, the application will be summarily rejected. If any information is found false or incorrect, or ineligibility is detected, the candidature will stand cancelled and the claim for recruitment will stand forfeited. The competent authority in Kalakshetra Foundation reserves the right to relax the eligibility criteria and other terms and conditions for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Kalakshetra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Consultant (Outreach and Museum). The notice does not print a number, so the post is counted as 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Kalakshetra Consultant (Outreach and Museum) application?
faq.answer: The application must reach Kalakshetra Foundation by 6 November 2026 (Friday). This is the last date for receipt.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Consultant (Outreach and Museum) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor Degree from a recognized University or a Diploma/Post Diploma from Kalakshetra Foundation. Knowledge of art and culture, especially Bharatanatyam/Carnatic Music/Visual arts/Crafts, and knowledge of Tamil and Hindi are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Kalakshetra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be older than 45 years on the closing date for receipt of applications, which is 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What salary does the Kalakshetra Consultant get?
faq.answer: The notice says the salary is commensurate with the experience. It does not print a fixed amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Kalakshetra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download and fill in the Annexure-I form completely, attach self-attested copies of your testimonials and send it by post. The address is The Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Anna Street, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai - 600 041.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Consultant (Outreach and Museum) post?
faq.answer: Kalakshetra Foundation will shortlist candidates and call them for an interview. Shortlisted candidates will be told the interview date and time later.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Kalakshetra Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on a contract basis for one year. The contract can be extended each year if the candidate's performance is satisfactory, and the appointment gives no claim to any regular appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Why can a Kalakshetra application be rejected?
faq.answer: An application will be summarily rejected if the experience certificate cannot be verified with the institution where the candidate last worked. Any false or incorrect information will lead to the candidature being cancelled.
